title: 2 How many thinges are neceſſarie for thee to know, that thou enioying this comfort maiſt liue & die happilie?

segments.text: Three. The firſt, what is the greatnes of my ſin, & miſery. The ſecond, how I am deliuered from all ſinne and miſerie. The third, what thankes I owe vnto God for this deliuerie.
